reuse.why: Fintegra goes through newly extracted linkBankSyncAccount/finishBankSyncLink and downloadBankSyncTransactions shared with the existing providers, and the takeover reuses the reset extracted from unlinkAccount (clearAccountBankLink).

duplication.why: Removes the copied per-provider link bodies and the Pluggy/Akahu download copies; the only repetition left is the one-line account-id getter per handler registration.

placement.why: Link-rule queries/assertions go to accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank, handler wiring stays in app.ts, downloads in sync.ts, URL in server-config.

scope.why: Consolidating the existing provider link and download functions goes beyond the request, but it directly serves adding Fintegra and the cross-provider rules; client edits are only required Record entries.

maintainability.why: Clear single guard and single link path; the higher-order refuseIfBankAccountLinked wrapper at registration time is a little indirect but keeps every provider covered.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers are wrapped by refuseIfBankAccountLinked; unlinkAccount and the takeover share clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: Former copies were merged into shared functions, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: refuseIfBankAccountLinked (app.ts) gained the closed-account call and a replaceExistingLink branch read from args; link.ts assertions stay single-purpose; no call site bypasses it.
